map.基于堰流公式计算溢洪道（实用堰/宽顶堰）泄流能力: Compute spillway discharge capacity by the weir-flow formula Q = m*b*sqrt(2g)*H^(3/2) for ogee or broad-crested weirs, for flood routing and outlet-works checks.
map.💡 堰流公式：Q=σs·ε·m·B·√(2g)·H₀^(3/2)；实用堰 m≈0: 💡 Weir formula: Q=σs·ε·m·B·√(2g)·H₀^(3/2); ogee m≈0.48–0.50, broad-crested m≈0.32–0.385
map.实用堰流量系数 m 随水头变化，设计水头下 WES 堰约 0.50: Ogee discharge coefficient m varies with head; at design head WES ≈ 0.50
map.宽顶堰 m 随堰高与水头比变化，通常取 0.32~0.385: Broad-crested m varies with weir height/head ratio, usually 0.32–0.385
map.侧收缩系数 ε 反映闸墩/边墩收缩影响，一般 0.90~0.98: Side-contraction coefficient ε reflects pier/abutment contraction, usually 0.90–0.98
map.校核校核洪水位下不超标泄。: Check discharge under check-flood level stays within limits.
map.闸门调控与自由出流比选。: Compare gate control vs free outflow.
map.m=0.49、b=20、H=3 → Q=0.49×20×√(2×9.81)×3^: m=0.49, b=20, H=3 → Q=0.49×20×√(2×9.81)×3^1.5≈225 m³/s; compare with safe downstream release.
map.H 从 3 增到 4，Q 增约 1.54 倍（H^1.5），高水位泄量陡增。: H 3→4 raises Q ~1.54× (H^1.5); high water spikes discharge.
map.下游水位低于坎顶为自由（用 H），淹没时受下游顶托泄量降。: Downstream below crest = free (use H); submerged flow is held back by tailwater, lower discharge.
map.流量系数，随堰型与行近流速变，宽顶堰约 0.32~0.385、实用堰更高。: Discharge coefficient; varies with weir type and approach velocity; broad-crested ~0.32–0.385, ogee higher.
map.溢洪道泄流量计算工具基于堰流公式计算溢洪道泄流能力。支持实用堰（WES 型）、宽: The spillway discharge tool computes spillway capacity by the weir formula. It supports ogee (WES), broad-crested and sharp-crested weirs, with discharge, side-contraction and submergence coefficients, computing discharge, unit discharge and approach velocity — core for reservoir spillway design and flood routing.
